villagerchatter.options.title: Villager Chatter
villagerchatter.options.chattiness.toolt: How likely a nearby villager is to say something each second you're close by. Off = villagers only talk when something happens (raids, bells, trades, hits).
villagerchatter.options.small_talk.toolt: When a villager talks, how often it chats with a neighbor instead of you, in a short back-and-forth you can overhear. Needs the AI.
villagerchatter.options.dialogue.tooltip: Villagers talk to you in the trading screen, with reply options to pick from.
villagerchatter.options.display.tooltip: Bubbles: speech bubbles above villagers' heads. Chat: lines in the chat box. Both: bubbles plus a copy in chat.
villagerchatter.options.bubble_size.tool: How big speech bubbles are. 100% is the original size.
villagerchatter.options.sounds.tooltip: Villagers make their "hrmm" sound when they say something: a happy one for good news, a grumpy one when they're upset.
villagerchatter.options.particles.toolti: Green sparkles, angry clouds, sweat drops and hearts that match what a villager says.
villagerchatter.options.ai.tooltip: Off: villagers only use hand-written lines, and the AI's memory (about 3 GB) is freed.
